physicalNotes: Radius 0.67 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Howard et al. 2025, the stellar radius of WASP-107 b's parameter set from Howard et al. 2025 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..278...52H/abstract): 466,119 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.683 +/- 0.017 solar masses from Piaulet et al. 2021, the stellar mass of WASP-107 b's parameter set from Piaulet et al. 2021 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...70P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4425 +/- 70 K from Howard et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of WASP-107 b's parameter set from Howard et al. 2025 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..278...52H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
